load_layer_norm_with_bias: load a LayerNorm layer with weight and bias tensors from a checkpoint using the monkey-patched load method
load_layer_norm_no_bias: load a LayerNorm layer with only weight tensors and no bias from a checkpoint using the monkey-patched load_no_bias method
use_fastlayernorm_cuda: use FastLayerNorm on CUDA to apply fused layer normalization with residual connection via dropout_layer_norm kernel
use_fastlayernorm_ipex: use FastLayerNorm on IPEX to apply layer normalization with residual connection via Intel extension for PyTorch
use_fastrmsnorm: use FastRMSNorm to apply RMS normalization with optional residual fusion supporting CUDA, ROCm, and IPEX backends
